summary: Accept as test-only hardening, not as a new runtime fix. The exact candidate changes only a registered regression test and report artifacts. The recorded base already contains the performance-preserving runtime solution: one independently serialized MultiprocessingSerializer payload per TP rank and rank-indexed deserialization. Independent spawned-process testing reproduced the legacy one-payload failure and verified three consecutive TP8-style per-rank loads plus TP1 with correct tensor contents.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, one shared ForkingPickler payload consumed by eight spawned processes produced exactly one success and seven EOFError failures. Three subsequent rounds using Engine._serialize_tensors_per_rank at tp_size=8 produced 24/24 successful rank-local deserializations with correct 65536-element count and sum 2147450880.0; TP1 also succeeded. Raw output: evidence/independent_reproduction_and_boundaries.txt

At exact candidate commit f36cc319163a0d3c5be588d5e9165ac2fd91062e, all three candidate tests passed: concurrent per-rank CPU tensor payload consumption, TP1 preservation, and flattened_bucket raw/base64 normalization. Raw output: evidence/candidate_regression.txt
The candidate changes one test and report artifacts only; it makes no Python runtime, C++, HIP, CUDA, or other native source change. Raw output: evidence/candidate_changed_files.txt

SGLang engine, TP worker, and serializer imported from /job/repo/python; PyTorch imported from /opt/venv and reported 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, one AMD Instinct MI350X GPU. Raw output: evidence/import_paths_and_architecture.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The reproduced defect is CPU tensor ForkingPickler/resource_sharer FD ownership and requires no GPU operation. The assigned environment exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), not the reported eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs.
remaining_limitations: No end-to-end TP8 SGLang server was run because only one gfx950 GPU was assigned.
No Qwen3-0.6B or LoRA weights were available, so model loading, generation semantics, unload behavior, and server-health behavior were not independently qualified.
The independent passing test validates the exact serializer ownership contract with spawned processes, not HTTP transport, a full scheduler lifecycle, multi-node execution, or NVIDIA H20 behavior.
The prepared checkout exactly matched the recorded base commit; its shallow graft prevents identifying the earlier commit that introduced the already-present runtime fix from local history.
